summary: VisionWave Holdings filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026 reporting receipt of a September 7, 2026 letter from the Liberia Petroleum Regulatory Authority approving its prequalification and inviting direct negotiations for a Production Sharing Contract under the Executive Allocation Framework. The letter names no block, acreage, commercial, fiscal or work-program terms, and grants no exclusivity or resource interest. VisionWave has no upstream oil and gas operations, reserves, licenses, revenue or assets tied to this matter. No session is scheduled. Risk-arb angle: headlines may move the microcap, but no binding award or economics exist; monitor negotiation commencement and any definitive PSC.
